pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: You're brought in to redesign the personalization engine for a mid-size e-commerce company. They have three years of purchase history, a CDP (customer data platform) that unifies behavioral signals across web and email, and they've just integrated a generative AI content layer that dynamically rewrites product descriptions for each user segment. Meanwhile, their ad team is under pressure because third-party cookies have been deprecated and their attribution model (the system that gives credit to the marketing touchpoints that led to a purchase) is now largely broken. Walk me through how you would architect a personalization and measurement system that works within these privacy constraints — what data assets you'd prioritize, how you'd handle attribution without third-party cookies, and what role the generative AI content layer plays in the overall measurement story.
